hero.title: Enterprise Software & SaaS Solutions
hero.subtitle: Empowering Sri Lankan Businesses with Practical Technology
hero.description: We design and develop enterprise software and SaaS solutions that simplify workforce management, connect teams, and turn complex business processes into efficient digital systems. From HR, payroll, attendance, and shift management to custom desktop, mobile, and cloud applications, we build secure, scalable software around the way your business operates.

expertise.title: Tailored Technology Solutions
expertise.description: We build practical software around real workforce and business operations, combining custom enterprise development with specialized SaaS platforms designed for efficiency, visibility, and growth.

services.title: Bespoke Software Development
services.description: Custom desktop applications, cloud systems, and mobile apps built to your exact specifications, ensuring scalability and security.

services.title: SaaS Platform Solutions
services.description: Specialized SaaS products including Hotel & Restaurant PMS, HRIS, ERP, POS, and more, designed for efficiency and growth.

technologies.title: Advanced Technology Stack
technologies.description: We use proven modern technologies to build secure, scalable, and maintainable software across web, cloud, desktop, mobile, and data environments.

about.title: About 4stax Labs
about.description: We are a Sri Lankan software development company focused on building enterprise applications and SaaS products that make everyday workforce and business operations simpler, faster, and easier to manage. Our team combines product thinking with practical engineering to deliver reliable solutions across desktop, mobile, cloud, and web environments.

testimonials.quote: Their bespoke software solution transformed the way our team manages daily operations. We now have better visibility, fewer manual steps, and a much smoother workflow.
testimonials.author: Michael Roberts

testimonials.quote: 4stax Labs took a complicated process and turned it into a straightforward digital workflow our staff could actually use. The team was responsive throughout the project.
testimonials.author: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.quote: The SaaS platform gave us a central place to manage information that had previously been spread across multiple tools. It has made day-to-day coordination much easier.
testimonials.author: Daniel Perera

testimonials.quote: From the initial requirements through deployment, the process felt practical and collaborative. The final system fits our workflow instead of forcing our team to change how we work.
testimonials.author: Emily Carter
